accountBinding: Upload practice media through the normal authenticated Studio entry. The starter is fresh and belongs to that account. This recipe transfers no owner, Storage path, cloud allowance or completed render.

steps.title: Open the practice source
steps.why: Use the same original recording so your teacher can compare before and after.

steps.title: Set the source interval
steps.control: Edited output position; Cut → Trim start to here; Trim end to here
steps.value: Seek to 1.0 s, trim start; seek to programme 6.0 s, trim end
steps.why: This keeps source seconds 1–7. After trimming the start, the programme clock begins at zero again.

steps.title: Choose the cut point
steps.why: This is the programme clock after trimming, not three seconds into the original file.

steps.title: Make a split
steps.why: A split creates two editable occurrences without deleting source footage.

steps.title: Check the cut
steps.why: The input, clicked action and result must still make sense.

steps.title: Save and export
steps.why: The exported duration should be six seconds. Reopen the editable project to retain both occurrences.
